scope: Local R4 implementation on top of existing M5e and R0-R3 changes. No commit, push, SDK upgrade or schema migration.

validation.coverage: Real PostgreSQL/pgvector with Spring/MyBatis rollback; loopback model/MCP/Feishu; independent JVM crash recovery; production Docker image using isolated synthetic-model probe.

initial_packaging_regression.cause: The separately packaged ZiweiRuntimeProbe referenced test-only TaskWorkerFixture, absent from its intentionally minimal launcher jar.
initial_packaging_regression.repair: Assemble the worker from production application services inside the standalone probe. Keep all test fixtures out of the product jar and rerun full clean verification.

validation.focused_atomicity_test_correction: Compare the pre-completion revision/events, not the original claim revision: native progress was durably committed before the completion transaction.

architecture.retained_debt: Legacy tools/channels and governance still use the TaskService compatibility facade; ReleaseCatalog/business configuration and native business drivers remain for R5.
architecture.spring_transaction_decision: Use existing TransactionTemplate and MyBatis-Spring. Reject ambient transactions around native execution; require an active transaction for task transitions. Keep command fence and SDK state CAS atomic.

deployment_image_evidence.scope: Real deployment image, production runtime and PostgreSQL; synthetic model in external test launcher only
